tools.name: hubflo_list_contacts
tools.description: List CRM contacts, filterable by e-mail, phone, company, project or owner. API: GET /api/v2/contacts.

tools.name: hubflo_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact with its tags (first 100). API: GET /api/v2/contacts/{id}.

tools.name: hubflo_create_contact
tools.description: Create a CRM contact. Writes customer data. API: POST /api/v2/contacts.

tools.name: hubflo_update_contact
tools.description: Change fields of one contact; only the fields you send change. Tags, when sent, replace the existing tags. API: PATCH /api/v2/contacts/{id}.

tools.name: hubflo_list_companies
tools.description: List companies, filterable by name, project, parent company, owner or contact. API: GET /api/v2/companies.

tools.name: hubflo_get_company
tools.description: Get one company with its tags (first 100). API: GET /api/v2/companies/{id}.

tools.name: hubflo_list_projects
tools.description: List projects, filterable by name, owner, contact or workspace. API: GET /api/v2/projects.

tools.name: hubflo_get_project
tools.description: Get one project with its tags (first 100). API: GET /api/v2/projects/{id}.

tools.name: hubflo_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks, filterable by project, contact, assignee, completion, overdue state or tag. API: GET /api/v2/tasks.

tools.name: hubflo_get_task
tools.description: Get one task with its tags (first 100). API: GET /api/v2/tasks/{id}.

tools.name: hubflo_create_task
tools.description: Create a task, optionally linked to a project or contact. Writes data visible to the team. API: POST /api/v2/tasks.

tools.name: hubflo_update_task
tools.description: Change fields of one task (for example mark it completed); only the fields you send change. API: PATCH /api/v2/tasks/{id}.

tools.name: hubflo_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices, filterable by contact, project or status. API: GET /api/v2/invoices.

tools.name: hubflo_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice with its totals and status. API: GET /api/v2/invoices/{id}.

tools.name: hubflo_list_flows
tools.description: List flows (running and finished workflows), newest first. API: GET /api/v2/flows.

tools.name: hubflo_get_flow
tools.description: Get one flow (without its roles and steps). API: GET /api/v2/flows/{id}.

tools.name: hubflo_list_notes
tools.description: List notes, filterable by contact or project. API: GET /api/v2/notes.

tools.name: hubflo_create_note
tools.description: Create a note in the library, optionally linked to projects or contacts. API: POST /api/v2/notes.

tools.name: hubflo_update_note
tools.description: Change the body or links of one note; only the fields you send change. API: PATCH /api/v2/notes/{id}.

tools.name: hubflo_list_chat_rooms
tools.description: List chat rooms, filterable by contact, user, name or type. API: GET /api/v2/chat_rooms.

tools.name: hubflo_list_chat_messages
tools.description: List messages of one chat room. API: GET /api/v2/chat_rooms/{id}/messages.

tools.name: hubflo_list_forms
tools.description: List the organization's forms. API: GET /api/v2/forms.

tools.name: hubflo_list_form_submissions
tools.description: List answers submitted to one form, filterable by contact or status. API: GET /api/v2/forms/{id}/submissions.

tools.name: hubflo_list_members
tools.description: List the members of the current organization, filterable by e-mail or role. API: GET /api/v2/members.

tools.name: hubflo_list_tags
tools.description: List the tags of the current organization. API: GET /api/v2/tags.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: hubflo_list_chat_rooms, hubflo_list_chat_messages · Private data: hubflo_list_contacts, hubflo_get_contact, hubflo_create_contact, hubflo_update_contact, hubflo_list_companies, hubflo_list_projects, hubflo_list_tasks, hubflo_create_task, hubflo_list_invoices, hubflo_list_notes, hubflo_create_note, hubflo_list_chat_rooms, hubflo_list_form_submissions · Public sink: hubflo_create_contact, hubflo_update_contact, hubflo_create_task, hubflo_update_task, hubflo_create_note, hubflo_update_note.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: hubflo_list_chat_rooms, hubflo_list_chat_messages · Private data: hubflo_list_contacts, hubflo_get_contact, hubflo_create_contact, hubflo_update_contact, hubflo_list_companies, hubflo_list_projects, hubflo_list_tasks, hubflo_create_task, hubflo_list_invoices, hubflo_list_notes, hubflo_create_note, hubflo_list_chat_rooms, hubflo_list_form_submissions · Public sink: hubflo_create_contact, hubflo_update_contact, hubflo_create_task, hubflo_update_task, hubflo_create_note, hubflo_update_note

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
